planned_only.name: E-stop and limit sensors pending
planned_only.source_line: LinuxCNC Forum member Rune_cnc describes restoring a Boxford 260 CMC training machine nicknamed “Phil,” which had been unused for six years at a school in Norway. In December 2024, the owner said the machine had been got working again and that a Mesa card was being installed as a replacement controller. A later post said safety additions, including an E-stop and limit sensors, still needed to be added. The inspected thread does not establish completed commissioning with LinuxCNC or the status of those safety changes.
